description: Shared digest vectors for GraphIR 4 document-symbol definitions (Coral Slice 60 step C0a). See user-symbol-digest-vectors.md beside this file.

vectors.name: minimal
vectors.description: Required members only.

vectors.name: stale-digest-member-removed
vectors.description: The digest member never enters the digest input, whatever its value.

vectors.name: default-label-side-present
vectors.description: labelSide "below" equals its default and is removed.

vectors.name: default-outline-present
vectors.description: outline "rectangle" equals its default and is removed.

vectors.name: default-tint-present
vectors.description: tint "none" equals its default and is removed.

vectors.name: all-defaults-present
vectors.description: All three defaults present at once are all removed.

vectors.name: label-side-above
vectors.description: A non-default labelSide is kept.

vectors.name: outline-rounded
vectors.description: A non-default outline is kept.

vectors.name: outline-ellipse
vectors.description: A non-default outline is kept.

vectors.name: outline-diamond
vectors.description: A non-default outline is kept.

vectors.name: tint-stroke
vectors.description: A non-default tint is kept.

vectors.name: full
vectors.description: Every member, already in sorted order.

vectors.name: full-permuted
vectors.description: The full vector with member order reversed at every level and tags, anchors and ports reversed.

vectors.name: port-anchor-omitted
vectors.description: A port without an anchor.

vectors.name: port-anchor-explicit-auto
vectors.description: An explicit {"kind": "auto"} anchor keeps its presence, so the digest differs from omission.

vectors.name: port-properties-default-looking-keys
vectors.description: Members inside port properties that look like defaults, digests or sortable arrays are never removed or reordered.

vectors.name: port-properties-proto-key
vectors.description: A "__proto__" member is ordinary JSON data and is kept and sorted like any other member.

vectors.name: member-names-sorted-by-utf16-code-units
vectors.description: RFC 8785 sorts member names by UTF-16 code units, so U+1F600 sorts before U+FB33.

properties.\u00f6: Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis

vectors.name: tags-sorted-by-code-point
vectors.description: Tags sort by code point, so U+FB33 sorts before U+1F600, unlike member names.

vectors.name: tags-permuted
vectors.description: The same tags in UTF-16 code unit order give the code point order digest.

vectors.name: port-ids-sorted-by-code-point
vectors.description: Ports sort by id code point, so U+FB33 sorts before U+1F600.

vectors.name: ports-permuted
vectors.description: Ports given in reverse id order.

vectors.name: anchors-boundary-and-interior
vectors.description: One boundary and one interior anchor in id order.

vectors.name: anchors-permuted
vectors.description: The same anchors in reverse id order.

vectors.name: provenance-license-only
vectors.description: Provenance with one member.

vectors.name: unicode-non-bmp
vectors.description: Non-BMP characters, one written raw and one as an escaped surrogate pair, serialize as raw UTF-8.

vectors.name: unicode-nfc
vectors.description: Precomposed U+00E9.

vectors.name: unicode-nfd
vectors.description: Decomposed e plus U+0301 is not normalized, so it differs from the precomposed form.

vectors.name: unicode-stacked-combining-marks
vectors.description: A base letter with several combining marks keeps their authored order.

vectors.name: string-escapes
vectors.description: RFC 8785 string escaping: short escapes, lowercase \u00XX controls, solidus and DEL, U+2028, U+2029 and U+FEFF raw.

vectors.name: control-characters-all
vectors.description: Every control character U+0000 to U+001F, each written as a \u escape: five use short escapes, the rest lowercase \u00XX.

vectors.name: control-characters-in-name
vectors.description: Tab, newline, escape and unit separator in name serialize as \t, \n, \u001b and \u001f.

vectors.name: numbers-size
vectors.description: Exponent and trailing-zero spellings of size serialize in shortest form.

vectors.name: numbers-large-size
vectors.description: 1e20 serializes as digits and 1e21 switches to exponent form.

vectors.name: numbers-anchors
vectors.description: Negative zero serializes as 0 and exponent spellings of fractions serialize in decimal form.

vectors.name: numbers-port-properties
vectors.description: JCS number formatting inside port properties, including the RFC 8785 examples.

vectors.name: lone-high-surrogate-in-name
vectors.description: A lone high surrogate cannot be canonicalized.

vectors.name: lone-low-surrogate-in-tag
vectors.description: A lone low surrogate in a tag cannot be canonicalized.

vectors.name: reversed-surrogate-pair-in-artwork
vectors.description: A low surrogate before a high surrogate in artwork text is two lone surrogates.

vectors.name: lone-surrogate-in-port-property-name
vectors.description: A lone surrogate in a member name inside port properties cannot be canonicalized.

vectors.name: empty-tags-refused
vectors.description: An empty tags array is schema-invalid and is refused before any digest is computed.

vectors.name: empty-anchors-refused
vectors.description: An empty anchors array is schema-invalid and is refused before any digest is computed.

vectors.name: empty-ports-refused
vectors.description: An empty ports array is schema-invalid and is refused before any digest is computed.

vectors.name: empty-provenance-refused
vectors.description: An empty provenance object is schema-invalid and is refused before any digest is computed.

vectors.name: empty-provenance-refused-before-lone-surrogate
vectors.description: Refusal of a schema-invalid input comes before canonicalization, so a lone surrogate elsewhere does not change the result.
